'''Hebesh''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Corporal/Legends|corporal]] affiliated with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] who resided on the war torn [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. He made his living as a medium armor vendor.
